phase.label: Foundation reset
phase.summary: Translate the confirmed operating model into the first acceptance-ready build slice.

focus.headline: Make the model easy to build—and easy to approve.
focus.detail: The project is moving from workflow discovery into a small, testable foundation. The next useful proof is a protected Learning Group and Level Offering workflow, with teacher discovery continuing in parallel.
focus.nextCheckpoint: A bounded first slice with written acceptance criteria and a staging review.

decisions.title: The operating model has a stable spine
decisions.detail: Client → optional Department → Learning Group → sequential Level Offering → Sessions. Student history remains available through Membership, Participation, and Attendance.

decisions.title: Classroom remains the teaching room
decisions.detail: Teachers continue using Google Classroom for coursework and grading. PL-OS reads academic data for reporting and health calculations; it does not write coursework back.

decisions.title: Acceptance resumes in small checkpoints
decisions.detail: The next review should accept one coherent slice, record any refinements, and identify the next slice. Broad open-ended testing waits for a complete workflow.

openQuestions.title: What exactly feeds the health score?
openQuestions.detail: Confirm how Classroom assignment completion, individual grades, missing work, late work, and justified work are represented in the scorecard.

openQuestions.title: How should the Client roster show unassigned people?
openQuestions.detail: Clarify the simple distinction between a Client Student with no current group, a waitlisted student, and an inactive former student.

openQuestions.title: Where does Cost Center belong?
openQuestions.detail: Keep it out of the first foundation slice until its reporting or billing ownership is clear.

actions.action: Shape the first Learning Group + Level Offering slice.
Walk through teacher attendance, grading, recording, and substitute processes.
Provide a deidentified example of the current grade and health-score calculation.
